purpose: Finite descriptor-driven reuse of a compute tile across nearby ROM banks. No host/software action per weight word.

configuration.boot_preload_note: At 16 bytes/cycle exclusive local config port. Shared die bus multiplies by clusters; immutable ROM templates eliminate external boot writes but still incur local fetch. No zero-cost hide assumed.
configuration.template_capacity_note: 256 templates is provisional; matrix shapes reuse templates with runtime bank/base/expert identities. Reject schedule whose distinct resident templates exceed this bound or price template refills.

descriptor.note: Fields total 512 bits; immutable layout and arithmetic + runtime identity form one descriptor. Runtime identity must not wrap while previous response can exist.

phase_cycles.compute_drain_cycles: D_arith supplied by selected exact compute engine; NOT zero
phase_cycles.read_capture_cycles: L_rom supplied by SS-qualified macro/capture plan
phase_cycles.network_forward_cycles: L_net supplied by routed cluster proposal
phase_cycles.minimum_no_overlap: 9 + ceil(A_bytes/A_port) + ceil(S_bytes/S_port) + L_rom + L_net + max(ceil(W_bytes/W_service), ceil(MACs/MAC_per_cycle), ceil(O_bytes/O_port)) + D_arith + stalls
phase_cycles.overlap_rule: Only lookahead descriptor fetch/operand fill with distinct FREE shadow slots may overlap current execution. Subtract overlap only when schedule proves input available and port conflict absent. No phase swap until prior output published and all old reads and compute responses drained.

flow_control.issue_rule: Consume one receive-buffer credit at accepted ROM read, not on return. ROM responses cannot be stalled after read acceptance. Credit returned after downstream consume frees slot.

port_demands.activation_read: compute_tile_activation_port bytes/cycle; local broadcast fanout priced by network
port_demands.activation_fill: A_port bytes/cycle; bank-disjoint from ACTIVE reader
port_demands.output_read: O_port bytes/cycle consumer; may require separate bank or true dual port

flow_control.stall_guarantee: Any downstream stall length is safe with finite credit admission; uninterrupted peak throughput guaranteed only under stated service/credit-latency bound. No arbitrary finite queue can hide unbounded consumer stall.
flow_control.retirement: Require issued==returned==consumed, arithmetic outstanding==0, output last accepted by publication buffer, and completion queue slot reserved. Source bank/operand slots remain bound to generation until this fence.
flow_control.cancel: Stop new issue; drain in-flight responses and arithmetic; drop only tagged canceled generation; free slots after drain. Never release ACTIVE slot immediately.
flow_control.completion_backpressure: Reserve completion slot at descriptor admission so compute completion cannot deadlock on queue fullness.

exactness.fetch_order: May vary bank/expert fetch order only with identity tagging and bounded reorder storage. Release arithmetic chunks and final expert contributions in golden order.
exactness.scale_binding: Weight payload, scale extent/generation, activation generation, format, K-tail and matrix mapping must all match active descriptor.
exactness.mutable_protection: SRAM and mutable owner/descriptor/control protection still required; overhead is excluded until selected memory/control implementation supplied, and must be added to physical inventory.
exactness.bounds: Validate bank range, byte count, row extent, format, K tail, operand extent, transaction generation and output extent at admission.

reuse.rtl/gpu/ot_gpu_expert_fetch.sv: Bulk descriptors, slot allocation, four-sector completion mask and ordered line release; do not copy HBM global arbitration blindly into ROM local network.
reuse.rtl/abi3/ot_a3_operand_bank_owner.sv: Two-bank ownership/tag contract. Caller must actually detect drain; controller alone does not.
reuse.rtl/abi3/ot_a3_event_scoreboard.sv: Dependency publication semantics available; full ABI wait engine prices four producers/cycle across three cycles and is unnecessary on critical path for fixed local graph.
reuse.rtl/hbm_accel/service/ot_hbm_accel_exper: Bounded lookahead, source-order fetch with golden-order staging release; HBM refresh/open-row logic is omitted.
reuse.rtl/hbm_accel/qwen/ot_hbmacc_qwen_wstrea: NOT a payload implementation: timing model preloads data and only signals arrival. Cannot support exact data-path claim.
reuse.rtl/ot_schedule_controller.sv: Quiescent active/shadow configuration concept only; existing CRC datapath is not mandated for ROM successor.

minimum_new_RTL: default-off bounded template/descriptor dispatcher with generation allocation
ROM bank burst walker with real macro read/capture timing
credit-reserved response pipeline and tagged payload landing
weight/scale/activation alignment adapter into existing exact reusable compute ports
drain-completion fence binding reusable owner to real read/compute counters
validation_required: single tile at full selected bank/operand width
reuse across at least two distinct ROM banks with different weights/scales and identical activation
consumer stalls longer than full pipeline credit round trip
back-to-back descriptors with same physical slots and different generations
late response and cancellation cannot mutate current generation
completion blocked beyond queue capacity causes admission backpressure
golden numerical compare including tails and scale boundaries
SS setup and FF hold in context before adoption

illustrative_buffer_sweep.warning: Do not aggregate all cluster banks into one global bus. These are per independent stream; replicate count scales storage and routing.
